task.title: Apart Sharing killer demo and pilot package v1
task.objective: Consolidate the existing communication, service recovery, reputation, revenue intelligence, and shadow pricing seams into one deterministic synthetic partner demo and evidence-disciplined pilot package.
acceptanceCriteria: One deterministic synthetic story reuses all three existing partner product pillars for Apartment 101.
The complete demo proves grounded communication, operational recovery, review correlation, advisory shadow pricing, and all no-side-effect guarantees.
Partner-facing presenter, pilot, economics, executive, data, discovery, and claims materials remain explicit about synthetic and not-yet-proven evidence.
No migration, production or staging action, external provider call, outbound message, public review publication, or OTA price write occurs.
Focused regressions, touched-file lint, typecheck, production build, diff checks, PR validation, commit, push, and draft PR complete successfully.
inScope: src/lib/partner-demo/ deterministic server-only orchestration and its focused full-story test
A lightweight deterministic demo command if repository conventions support it
Partner demo, pilot, economics, executive, data-contract, discovery, operating-model, and claims documentation
Package script changes strictly required for the demo command
Draft PR publication from a fresh task branch
outOfScope: New product engines or duplicated domain logic
Real Apart Sharing integration or credentials
External calls, outbound guest messages, public review publication, OTA price writes, or automated financial decisions
Unsupported commercial, staffing, reputation, or revenue claims
